_comment: CDC scenario INITIAL LOAD UNDER LIVE CHANGES, --trx-mode serial: PostgreSQL CDC over logical decoding (wal2json) of the domain's own replication slot (created with the domain, named after it, reused by the publisher); every model table REPLICA IDENTITY FULL, so the two keyless tables log their updates and deletes with whole before-images. wal2json carries the rows an ON DELETE CASCADE takes and an UPDATE that sets the values a row has: --cascades logged --noops logged. The initial load is taken while modify-data churns, its transactions one transaction at a time. STAGES: (1) domains -- create the postgrescdc domain, install employeescdc, load the m seed (10k rows a table), its operations appended to ${xp:dir}/ops.jsonl; (2) actions, tagged live -- `sentinel-data --key after-create-data`, then `churn` in the background: 20 passes a second apart of `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 250 --trx-mode serial`, every set one transaction of one verb over all five tables -- inserts, updates (accounts' moving its key), deletes; it keeps running through the stages below; (3) collections and (4) functions -- register postgrescdc_initial_load_live (initial_load=True), which STARTS it: its load is taken over tables changing under it; (5) actions, tagged live -- wait for churn, then `sentinel-data --key after-churn`; (6) sentinel -- hold until both keys arrive; (7) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py --check state: the load plus every change applied in commit order as the connector deduplicates must leave each table as the whole trail does; on the keyless tables (devices, readings) a change the load already holds may arrive again, counted, not refused; nothing of audit; (8) monitor. Generated by gen_suites.py. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite cdc/postgrescdc_initial_load_live_serial --keep`.
